description: Attribute search within one geo.admin.ch layer (MapServer/find): returns features whose field contains (or equals) the text. Examples: layer_id='ch.bfs.gebaeude_wohnungs_register', search_field='egid', search_text='1231641', contains=false; layer_id='ch.bafu.bundesinventare-bln', search_field='bln_name', search_text='Aletsch'. Use get_layer_info to see field names.

contains.description: true = substring match (default), false = exact match

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

layer_id.description: geo.admin.ch layer id (BOD id), e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag', find ids with search_map_layers

search_text.description: Value or substring to look for

name: find_layer_features
title: Search a geo.admin.ch layer by attribute value
